'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Operation Claw-Lock]]
***[[Zakho resort attack]]
****Iraqi government and regional authorities claim that [[Turkish Armed Forces]] fired four missiles at a resort in the [[Zakho District]] of [[Kurdistan Region]] in [[Iraq]], killing eight Iraqi tourists and injuring 23 others. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-turkey-iraq-baghdad-7488a761ef3fc1115a2307701d4be50c (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] says that his country's military goals are no longer limited to the [[Donbas]] region and have expanded to also include "the [[Kherson region]], the [[Zaporizhzhia region]] and a number of other territories". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/20/lavrov-says-russia-military-goals-not-focused-only-on-donbas (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] raids [[Yeed]] and Aato in [[Bakool]], [[Somalia]], near the [[Ethiopia–Somalia relations|Ethiopian border]]. Fourteen [[Ethiopia]]n police officers and three civilians are killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalias-al-shabaab-group-rare-attack-near-ethiopia-border-2022-07-21/ (Reuters)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/al-shabab-attacks-somali-towns-close-to-ethiopian-border-/6667670.html (VOA)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Inflation]] in the [[United Kingdom]] increased to 9.4% last month, breaking a 40-year record, as food and fuel prices continue to increase. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2022/jul/20/uk-inflation-rise-new-peak-fuel-food-prices-business-live (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russia in the European energy sector]]
**The [[European Commission]] tells [[European Commission|EU]] member states to reduce gas usage by 15% until March 2023 as part of an emergency plan after [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] warns that Russian supplies of [[natural gas]] could be reduced further. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/europe-races-cut-russian-gas-usage-amid-new-putin-warning-2022-07-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**The [[European Union]] bans imports of gold from [[Russia]] and freezes [[Sberbank]]'s assets. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2022/07/20/eu-bans-imports-of-russian-gold-and-freezes-sberbanks-assets (Euronews)]
*[[Economy of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine]]'s government, facing an estimated 35% to 45% decrease in GDP, asks its international creditors to freeze its debt payments for two years, including a $1.2 billion debt payment due at the beginning of September. The proposal is backed by major Western governments and other major lenders. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-intends-postpone-debt-payments-24-months-government-resolution-2022-07-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 European heat wave]]
**Six [[States of Germany|federal states]] of [[Germany]] ([[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Hamburg]], [[Lower Saxony]], [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]], [[Saxony-Anhalt]] and [[Schleswig-Holstein]]) see their all-time high records beaten, with the highest temperature, {{cvt|40.3|C|F}}, set at [[Bad Mergentheim]]. [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/hitzewelle-deutschland-123.html (''Tagesschau'')]
**Abed, a hamlet on the [[Denmark|Danish]] island of [[Lolland]], sets the highest July temperature recorded in the country, reaching {{cvt|35.9|C|F}}. [https://www.dr.dk/nyheder/indland/det-er-ikke-nogen-lille-vejrrekord-det-her-det-er-vejrhistorie-varmeste-julidag (Danish Broadcasting Corporation)]
*A [[United States Army]] soldier is killed and nine others are injured after a lightning strike at a training area at [[Fort Gordon]] in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2022/07/20/lighting-strike-fort-gordon-ga-10-people-injured/10113216002/ (''USA Today'')]
*One person is killed and 23 others are injured after a tornado hits [[Jiangsu]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tornadoes-china-beijing-climate-and-environment-b4efa6802cd836ce8bb8e28fa39c8197 (AP)]
